Strand waterfall: ordered sequence of selection strategies.\n//!\n//! The StrandRunner evaluates strands in priority order. The first strand\n//! that yields a candidate wins. Strands are stateless — they receive queue\n//! state and return a candidate or nothing.\n//!\n//! Depends on: `types`, `config`, `bead_store`.\n\nmod explore;\nmod knot;\npub mod mend;\nmod pluck;\npub mod pulse;\npub mod reflect;\npub mod splice;\npub mod unravel;\npub mod weave;\n\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::time::Instant;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse tracing::Instrument;\n\nuse crate::bead_store::BeadStore;\nuse crate::config::Config;\nuse crate::span::{attrs, strand_results};\nuse crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, StrandResult};\n\n/// A single strand evaluation result.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct StrandEvaluation {\n    pub strand_name: String,\n    pub result: String,\n    pub duration_ms: u64,\n}\n\n/// Result of a single `StrandRunner::select()` call.\n///\n/// Carries both the winning candidate (if any) and diagnostic statistics\n/// about restarts that occurred during the waterfall — used to populate\n/// `worker.exhausted` telemetry with a per-iteration breakdown.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct SelectOutcome {\n    /// The candidate bead and the strand that found it, or `None` if\n    /// all strands returned `NoWork`.\n    pub bead: Option<(Bead, String)>,\n    /// How many times the waterfall restarted from Pluck (cap = `MAX_RESTARTS`).\n    pub waterfall_restarts: u32,\n    /// Names of strands that returned `WorkCreated` and triggered a restart.\n    /// Duplicate entries are preserved (one per restart event).\n    pub restart_triggers: Vec<String>,\n    /// All strand evaluations in order, across all waterfall passes.\n    /// Each entry is (strand_name, result, duration_ms).\n    pub strand_evaluations: Vec<StrandEvaluation>,\n    /// If set, this bead should be dispatched with a split prompt instead of\n    /// the normal work prompt. Contains the consecutive failure count.\n    pub split_failure_count: Option<u32>,\n}\n\npub use explore::ExploreStrand;\npub use knot::KnotStrand;\npub use mend::{cleanup_orphaned_in_progress, MendStrand};\npub use pluck::PluckStrand;\npub use pulse::PulseStrand;\npub use reflect::{CliReflectAgent, ReflectAgent, ReflectStrand};\npub use splice::SpliceStrand;\npub use unravel::{UnravelAgent, UnravelStrand};\npub use weave::{CliWeaveAgent, WeaveAgent, WeaveStrand};\n\n/// A single selection strategy in the waterfall.\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\npub trait Strand: Send + Sync {\n    /// Human-readable name for telemetry.\n    fn name(&self) -> &str;\n\n    /// Evaluate this strand against the current queue state.\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult;\n}\n\n/// Runs strands in order, returning the first candidate found.\npub struct StrandRunner {\n    strands: Vec<Box<dyn Strand>>,\n    telemetry: crate::telemetry::Telemetry,\n}\n\nimpl StrandRunner {\n    pub fn new(strands: Vec<Box<dyn Strand>>) -> Self {\n        StrandRunner {\n            strands,\n            telemetry: crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(\"strand-runner\".to_string()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Build the default strand waterfall from config.\n    ///\n    /// The waterfall order is:\n    /// Pluck → Mend → Explore → Weave → Unravel → Pulse → Reflect → Splice → Knot.\n    pub fn from_config(\n        config: &Config,\n        worker_id: &str,\n        registry: crate::registry::Registry,\n        telemetry: crate::telemetry::Telemetry,\n    ) -> Self {\n        let pluck = PluckStrand::with_persistent_records(\n            config.strands.pluck.exclude_labels.clone(),\n            config.strands.pluck.split_after_failures,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            config.workspace.home.clone(),\n            config.strands.pluck.persistent_starvation_records,\n        );\n\n        let heartbeat_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\").join(\"heartbeats\");\n        let heartbeat_ttl = std::time::Duration::from_secs(config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs);\n        let lock_dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\");\n        let log_dir = config\n            .telemetry\n            .file_sink\n            .log_dir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| config.workspace.home.join(\"logs\"));\n        let retention_days = config.telemetry.file_sink.retention_days;\n        let traces_dir = config.workspace.default.join(\".beads\").join(\"traces\");\n        let trace_retention_failed_days = config.strands.learning.trace_retention_failed_days;\n        let trace_retention_success_days = config.strands.learning.trace_retention_success_days;\n\n        // Create a new Registry instance pointing to the same path for ExploreStrand.\n        // We need to get the state_dir_for_explore before moving registry to MendStrand.\n        let state_fallback = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\");\n        let state_dir_for_explore = registry.path().parent().unwrap_or(&state_fallback);\n        let explore_registry = crate::registry::Registry::new(state_dir_for_explore);\n\n        let mend = MendStrand::new(\n            config.strands.mend.clone(),\n            heartbeat_dir,\n            heartbeat_ttl,\n            lock_dir,\n            worker_id.to_string(),\n            registry,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            log_dir,\n            retention_days,\n            traces_dir,\n            trace_retention_failed_days,\n            trace_retention_success_days,\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            config.strands.learning.max_learnings,\n            config.workspace.home.join(\"state\"),\n            config.limits.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let state_base = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\");\n\n        let explore = ExploreStrand::new(\n            config.strands.explore.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            explore_registry,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            worker_id.to_string(),\n        );\n\n        let weave = WeaveStrand::new(\n            config.strands.weave.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"weave\"),\n            Box::new(CliWeaveAgent::new(config.agent.default.clone())),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let unravel = UnravelStrand::new(\n            config.strands.unravel.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"unravel\"),\n            Box::new(unravel::CliUnravelAgent::new(config.agent.default.clone())),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let pulse = PulseStrand::new(\n            config.strands.pulse.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"pulse\"),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        // Create the extraction agent if configured.\n        let reflect_agent = config\n            .strands\n            .reflect\n            .extraction_agent\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|agent_cmd| {\n                Box::new(reflect::CliReflectAgent::new(\n                    agent_cmd.clone(),\n                    config.strands.reflect.extraction_prompt_template.clone(),\n                )) as Box<dyn reflect::ReflectAgent>\n            });\n\n        let reflect = ReflectStrand::new(\n            config.strands.reflect.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"reflect\"),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            reflect_agent,\n        );\n\n        // Reconstruct heartbeat_dir for Splice (same path used by Mend).\n        let splice_heartbeat_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\").join(\"heartbeats\");\n        let runner_telemetry = telemetry.clone();\n\n        // VALIDATION: Warn loudly if Splice is enabled but report_workspace is unset.\n        // This is a critical configuration gap - without report_workspace, Splice will\n        // silently fail to create escalation beads, missing the entire point of detection.\n        if config.strands.splice.enabled && config.strands.splice.report_workspace.is_none() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                \"━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Splice strand is ENABLED but strands.splice.report_workspace is NOT SET!\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Worker failure and live-loop detection will NOT create escalation beads.\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 To fix, add to your ~/.config/needle/config.yaml:\\\n                 \\n\\\n                   strands:\\\n                     splice:\\\n                       report_workspace: /path/to/your/workspace\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Or set NEEDLE_STRANDS__SPLICE__REPORT_WORKSPACE=/path/to/workspace\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        let splice = SpliceStrand::new(\n            config.strands.splice.clone(),\n            splice_heartbeat_dir,\n            state_base.join(\"splice\"),\n            telemetry,\n        );\n\n        let knot = KnotStrand::new(config.strands.knot.clone(), runner_telemetry.clone());\n        StrandRunner {\n            strands: vec![\n                Box::new(pluck),\n                Box::new(mend),\n                Box::new(explore),\n                Box::new(weave),\n                Box::new(unravel),\n                Box::new(pulse),\n                Box::new(reflect),\n                Box::new(splice),\n                Box::new(knot),\n            ],\n            telemetry: runner_telemetry,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Run the waterfall, returning a `SelectOutcome` that carries the winning\n    /// candidate (if any) plus restart diagnostics.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the full `Bead` (including its workspace path) so the caller\n    /// can create the correct bead store for remote beads found by Explore.\n    /// The accompanying `String` is the name of the strand that produced the\n    /// candidate.\n    ///\n    /// When a strand returns `WorkCreated`, the waterfall restarts from Pluck.\n    /// A restart cap prevents infinite loops (e.g. a strand that always creates\n    /// work without producing a claimable bead).\n    pub async fn select(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>,\n    ) -> Result<SelectOutcome> {\n        const MAX_RESTARTS: u32 = 3;\n        let mut restarts = 0u32;\n        let mut restart_triggers: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        let mut strand_evaluations: Vec<StrandEvaluation> = Vec::new();\n\n        'waterfall: loop {\n            for strand in &self.strands {\n                let strand_name = strand.name().to_string();\n                let strand_span = tracing::info_span!(\n                    \"strand.{}\",\n                    strand_name,\n                    needle.strand.name = %strand_name,\n                );\n                let start = Instant::now();\n                let result = strand\n                    .evaluate(store, exclusions)\n                    .instrument(strand_span.clone())\n                    .await;\n                let elapsed_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n\n                // The remaining evaluation bookkeeping is synchronous, so a\n                // scoped guard is safe here and preserves strand context on its\n                // tracing events without crossing an `.await`.\n                let _strand_enter = strand_span.enter();\n\n                // Record strand evaluation result as span attribute.\n                let (result_str, should_record) = match &result {\n                    StrandResult::BeadFound(beads) => {\n                        let count = beads.len();\n                        (\n                            format!(\"{}({})\", strand_results::BEAD_FOUND, count),\n                            count > 0,\n                        )\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::WorkCreated => (strand_results::WORK_CREATED.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::NoWork => (strand_results::NO_WORK.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::Error(_) => (strand_results::ERROR.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::Skipped { reason } => (format!(\"skipped({})\", reason), true),\n                    StrandResult::Split(_, _failure_count) => {\n                        (format!(\"{}({})\", strand_results::BEAD_FOUND, 1), true)\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::FoundButExcluded => (\"found_but_excluded\".to_string(), true),\n                };\n                tracing::Span::current().record(attrs::NEEDLE_STRAND_RESULT, &result_str);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(attrs::NEEDLE_STRAND_DURATION_MS, elapsed_ms);\n\n                // Set strand span status: Error for strand errors, Ok for all other results\n                // Note: Skipped is not an error - it's expected for roam-only workers\n                if matches!(result, StrandResult::Error(_)) {\n                    tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                    tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", &result_str);\n                }\n\n                // Only record evaluations that produced meaningful results.\n                // Skip recording empty BeadFound results since they don't\n                // represent actual strand activity.\n                if should_record {\n                    strand_evaluations.push(StrandEvaluation {\n                        strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                        result: result_str.clone(),\n                        duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                    });\n                }\n\n                match result {\n                    StrandResult::BeadFound(beads) => {\n                        // Filter out beads that are in the exclusion set (e.g.\n                        // recently race-lost).  This prevents the waterfall from\n                        // immediately re-selecting a bead that just lost a claim\n                        // race to another worker.\n                        let original_count = beads.len();\n                        let filtered: Vec<Bead> = beads\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .filter(|b| !exclusions.contains(&b.id))\n                            .collect();\n                        let excluded_count = original_count.saturating_sub(filtered.len());\n\n                        // Record queue depth for the Pluck strand (after filtering).\n                        // This samples the current queue depth for the needle.queue.depth\n                        // observable gauge, which is measured at strand evaluation.\n                        // We report depth per priority level to enable filtered views.\n                        if strand_name == \"pluck\" {\n                            use std::collections::HashMap;\n                            let mut depths: HashMap<u8, u64> = HashMap::new();\n                            for bead in &filtered {\n                                *depths.entry(bead.priority).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                            }\n                            self.telemetry.record_queue_depth(depths);\n                        }\n\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"bead_found\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            candidates = filtered.len(),\n                            excluded = excluded_count,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand found candidates\"\n                        );\n                        if let Some(bead) = filtered.into_iter().next() {\n                            return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                                bead: Some((bead, strand_name.clone())),\n                                waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                                restart_triggers,\n                                strand_evaluations,\n                                split_failure_count: None,\n                            });\n                        }\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Split(bead, failure_count) => {\n                        let bead = *bead;\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"split\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            failure_count,\n                            \"strand triggered split for bead with excessive failures\"\n                        );\n                        return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                            bead: Some((bead, strand_name.clone())),\n                            waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                            restart_triggers,\n                            strand_evaluations,\n                            split_failure_count: Some(failure_count),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::WorkCreated => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"work_created\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        restarts += 1;\n                        restart_triggers.push(strand_name.clone());\n                        if restarts > MAX_RESTARTS {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                max_restarts = MAX_RESTARTS,\n                                \"waterfall restart cap reached, continuing to evaluate remaining strands\"\n                            );\n                            // Do NOT return None — continue evaluating remaining strands\n                            // so every strand emits telemetry and the operator can see\n                            // why the worker is idle.\n                            continue;\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            restart = restarts,\n                            \"strand created new work, restarting waterfall\"\n                        );\n                        continue 'waterfall;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::NoWork => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"no_work\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand returned no work\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Skipped { reason } => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: format!(\"skipped({})\", reason),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            reason = %reason,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand skipped\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::FoundButExcluded => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"found_but_excluded\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand found candidates but all were excluded/assigned, triggering short retry\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Error(e) => {\n                        if let Err(te) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"error\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %te,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            error = %e,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand error, continuing to next strand\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // All strands evaluated without finding work or triggering a restart.\n            return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                bead: None,\n                waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n                split_failure_count: None,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Return the names of all configured strands (for telemetry/debugging).\n    pub fn strand_names(&self) -> Vec<&str> {\n        self.strands.iter().map(|s| s.name()).collect()\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests The bead is NOT decomposed.\n282\t///   It is either retried, released, or escalated based on the failure type\n283\t///   and consecutive failure count.\n284\t///\n285\t/// # When to use each mode\n286\t///\n287\t/// **Use `Timeout` mode when:**\n288\t/// - An agent process exits with code 124 (GNU timeout) or times out via another wrapper\n289\t/// - The bead has made progress but exceeded its time budget\n290\t/// - The work can be meaningfully split into discrete phases\n291\t/// - Child beads can complete the work with the same or reduced timeout\n292\t///\n293\t/// **Use `OrdinaryFailure` mode when:**\n294\t/// - Exit codes 1-123, 125-128 (failure codes) or 127 (agent not found)\n295\t/// - Exit codes >128 (signal crashes)\n296\t/// - Negative exit codes (abnormal termination)\n297\t/// - The failure is NOT time-related and splitting won't help\n298\t///\n299\t/// # API boundary\n300\t///\n301\t/// This enum is the sole discriminator for whether the decomposition path is\n302\t/// activated. No other code should check timeout status or exit codes to make\n303\t/// this decision — all decomposition logic should route through this enum.\n304\t#[non_exhaustive]\n305\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n306\t#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\n307\tpub enum DecompositionMode {\n308\t    /// Timeout-driven decomposition mode.\n309\t    ///\n310\t    /// Contains timeout-specific context for use in generating child bead\n311\t    /// proposals (e.g., original timeout value, elapsed time, progress indicators).\n312\t    Timeout {\n313\t        /// The timeout duration that was exceeded (in seconds).\n314\t        timeout_seconds: u64,\n315\t        /// Optional hint about what phase was being worked on when timeout occurred.\n316\t        /// This can be used to name the first child bead (e.g., \"Phase 1: Routing Rules\").\n317\t        current_phase_hint: Option<String>,\n318\t    },\n319\t    /// Ordinary failure mode — no decomposition.\n320\t    ///\n321\t    /// Used for all non-timeout failures where splitting the bead into child\n322\t    /// beads would not help. The bead should be retried, released, or escalated\n323\t    /// via the normal failure-handling path.\n324\t    OrdinaryFailure,\n325\t}\n326\t\n327\timpl DecompositionMode {\n328\t    /// Returns true if this is timeout decomposition mode.\n329\t    ///\n330\t    /// This is the primary query method for routing to the decomposition path.\n331\t    /// All code that needs to know whether to decompose should call this method\n332\t    /// rather than inspecting the enum directly.\n333\t    ///\n334\t    /// # Examples\n335\t    ///\n336\t    /// ```\n337\t    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n338\t    ///\n339\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n340\t    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n341\t    ///     current_phase_hint: Some(\"Phase 1\".to_string()),\n342\t    /// };\n343\t    /// assert!(mode.is_timeout());\n344\t    ///\n345\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n346\t    /// assert!(!mode.is_timeout());\n347\t    /// ```\n348\t    pub fn is_timeout(&self) -> bool {\n349\t        matches!(self, DecompositionMode::Timeout { .. })\n350\t    }\n351\t\n352\t    /// Returns true if this is ordinary failure mode.\n353\t    ///\n354\t    /// This is the primary query method for routing to the normal failure\n355\t    /// handling path (retry, release, or escalate without decomposition).\n356\t    ///\n357\t    /// # Examples\n358\t    ///\n359\t    /// ```\n360\t    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n361\t    ///\n362\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n363\t    /// assert!(mode.is_ordinary_failure());\n364\t    ///\n365\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n366\t    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n367\t    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n368\t    /// };\n369\t    /// assert!(!mode.is_ordinary_failure());\n370\t    /// ```\n371\t    pub fn is_ordinary_failure(&self) -> bool {\n372\t        matches!(self, DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure)\n373\t    }\n374\t\n375\t    /// Returns the timeout duration if in timeout mode, None otherwise.\n376\t    ///\n377\t    /// This is a convenience method for extracting the timeout value without\n378\t    /// pattern matching. Returns `None` for `OrdinaryFailure` mode.\n379\t    ///\n380\t    /// # Examples\n381\t    ///\n382\t    /// ```\n383\t    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n384\t    ///\n385\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n386\t    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n387\t    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n388\t    /// };\n389\t    /// assert_eq!(mode.timeout_seconds(), Some(120));\n390\t    ///\n391\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n392\t    /// assert_eq!(mode.timeout_seconds(), None);\n393\t    /// ```\n394\t    pub fn timeout_seconds(&self) -> Option<u64> {\n395\t        match self {\n396\t            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n397\t                timeout_seconds, ..\n398\t            } => Some(*timeout_seconds),\n399\t            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => None,\n400\t        }\n401\t    }\n402\t\n403\t    /// Returns the current phase hint if in timeout mode, None otherwise.\n404\t    ///\n405\t    /// This is a convenience method for extracting the optional phase hint\n406\t    /// without pattern matching. Returns `None` for `OrdinaryFailure` mode\n407\t    /// or when the hint is not set.\n408\t    ///\n409\t    /// # Examples\n410\t    ///\n411\t    /// ```\n412\t    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n413\t    ///\n414\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n415\t    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n416\t    ///     current_phase_hint: Some(\"Phase 1\".to_string()),\n417\t    /// };\n418\t    /// assert_eq!(mode.current_phase_hint(), Some(&\"Phase 1\".to_string()));\n419\t    ///\n420\t    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n421\t    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n422\t    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n423\t    /// };\n424\t    /// assert_eq!(mode.current_phase_hint(), None);\n425\t    /// ```\n426\t    pub fn current_phase_hint(&self) -> Option<&String> {\n427\t        match self {\n428\t            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n429\t                current_phase_hint, ..\n430\t            } => current_phase_hint.as_ref(),\n431\t            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => None,\n432\t        }\n433\t    }\n434\t}\n435\t\n436\timpl fmt::Display for DecompositionMode {\n437\t    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n438\t        match self {\n439\t            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n440\t                timeout_seconds, ..\n441\t            } => write!(f, \"timeout ({}s)\", timeout_seconds),\n442\t            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => write!(f, \"ordinary_failure\"),\n443\t        }\n444\t    }\n445\t}\n446\t\n447\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n448\t// StrandError / StrandResult\n449\t// Treat as equivalent\n    /// to `Done` so deserialization succeeds.\n    Closed,\n    Blocked,\n    /// `bf` (bead-forge) emits `\"deferred\"` for beads deliberately postponed\n    /// rather than blocked by a dependency. Distinct from `Blocked`: a\n    /// deferred bead has no unmet dependency, it was just set aside — see\n    /// GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#10. Without this variant, `bf list --json`\n    /// fails deserialization for every such bead, and it silently disappears\n    /// from strand/supervise visibility with no surfaced error.\n    Deferred,\n}\n\nimpl BeadStatus {\n    /// Returns true if the bead is finished (either `Done` or `Closed`).\n    pub fn is_done(&self) -> bool {\n        matches!(self, BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for BeadStatus {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            BeadStatus::Open => write!(f, \"open\"),\n            BeadStatus::InProgress => write!(f, \"in_progress\"),\n            BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed => write!(f, \"done\"),\n            BeadStatus::Blocked => write!(f, \"blocked\"),\n            BeadStatus::Deferred => write!(f, \"deferred\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// WorkerState\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Worker finite-state-machine states.\n///\n/// Every state has defined entry conditions, actions, and exit transitions.\n/// There are no implicit states or fallthrough paths.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE\")]\npub enum WorkerState {\n    Booting,\n    Selecting,\n    Claiming,\n    Retrying,\n    Building,\n    Dispatching,\n    Executing,\n    Handling,\n    Logging,\n    /// All strands returned empty — worker has nothing to do.\n    Exhausted,\n    /// Received graceful shutdown signal.\n    Stopped,\n    /// Unrecoverable error.\n    Errored,\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for WorkerState {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        let s = match self {\n            WorkerState::Booting => \"BOOTING\",\n            WorkerState::Selecting => \"SELECTING\",\n            WorkerState::Claiming => \"CLAIMING\",\n            WorkerState::Retrying => \"RETRYING\",\n            WorkerState::Building => \"BUILDING\",\n            WorkerState::Dispatching => \"DISPATCHING\",\n            WorkerState::Executing => \"EXECUTING\",\n            WorkerState::Handling => \"HANDLING\",\n            WorkerState::Logging => \"LOGGING\",\n            WorkerState::Exhausted => \"EXHAUSTED\",\n            WorkerState::Stopped => \"STOPPED\",\n            WorkerState::Errored => \"ERRORED\",\n        };\n        f.write_str(s)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Outcome\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// The classified outcome of an agent process.\n///\n/// Every exit code maps to exactly one variant via `Outcome::classify()`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Outcome {\n    /// Exit 0 — agent completed work successfully.\n    Success,\n    /// Non-zero exit indicating a failure (includes app errors 1-99 and unknown codes).\n    Failure,\n    /// Exit 100 or 124 — timeout wrapper expired.\n    Timeout,\n    /// Exit 126 or 127 — agent binary not found or not executable.\n    AgentNotFound,\n    /// Exit 130 (SIGINT) or 143 (SIGTERM) — agent was interrupted.\n    Interrupted,\n    /// Negative exit code — process crashed or was killed by a signal.\n    Crash(i32),\n}\n\nimpl Outcome {\n    /// Classify an exit code into an `Outcome` variant.\n    ///\n    /// Every exit code range has an explicit match arm — no wildcards.\n    /// The `was_interrupted` flag takes precedence over exit code analysis.\n    ///\n    /// # Mapping (per spec)\n    /// - `was_interrupted=true` → `Interrupted` (checked first)\n    /// - exit 0 → `Success`\n    /// - exit 1 → `Failure`\n    /// - exit 124 → `Timeout`\n    /// - exit 127 → `AgentNotFound`\n    /// - exit >128 → `Crash(exit_code)`\n    /// - exit <0 → `Crash(exit_code)`\n    /// - all other → `Failure`\n    pub fn classify(exit_code: i32, was_interrupted: bool) -> Self {\n        // Interrupted flag takes precedence (graceful shutdown path).\n        if was_interrupted {\n            return Outcome::Interrupted;\n        }\n\n        // Explicit mapping for every exit code range — NO wildcards.\n        // Each range is explicitly enumerated to ensure compile errors\n        // if a new Outcome variant is added without updating this match.\n        match exit_code {\n            // Success\n            0 => Outcome::Success,\n            // Explicit failure code\n            1 => Outcome::Failure,\n            // Timeout (GNU timeout exit code)\n            124 => Outcome::Timeout,\n            // Agent not found (shell exit code for missing command)\n            127 => Outcome::AgentNotFound,\n            // Failure range: 2-123\n            2..=123 => Outcome::Failure,\n            // Failure: 125-128 (not >128 per spec, so 128 is not Crash)\n            125..=128 => Outcome::Failure,\n            // Signal exits: >128 (128 + signal number)\n            // These are all crashes per the spec.\n            129..=i32::MAX => Outcome::Crash(exit_code),\n            // Negative exit codes (abnormal termination)\n            i32::MIN..=-1 => Outcome::Crash(exit_code),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Return a string representation for telemetry/logging.\n    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Outcome::Success => \"success\",\n            Outcome::Failure => \"failure\",\n            Outcome::Timeout => \"timeout\",\n            Outcome::AgentNotFound => \"agent_not_found\",\n            Outcome::Interrupted => \"interrupted\",\n            Outcome::Crash(_) => \"crash\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// DecompositionMode\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Mode distinguishing timeout-driven decomposition from ordinary failure handling.\n///\n/// This enum defines the API boundary between two distinct failure-handling paths:\n/// - **Timeout mode**: Activated when a bead times out. The bead is decomposed\n///   into smaller child beads via `ChildBeadProposal`, each representing a\n///   phase of the original work. This is a recovery strategy for work that\n///   exceeded its time budget but may still be completable in smaller pieces.\n/// - **OrdinaryFailure mode**: Activated for any non-timeout failure (compilation\n///   error, test failure, agent crash, etc.). The bead is NOT decomposed.\n///   It is either retried, released, or escalated based on the failure type\n///   and consecutive failure count.\n///\n/// # When to use each mode\n///\n/// **Use `Timeout` mode when:**\n/// - An agent process exits with code 124 (GNU timeout) or times out via another wrapper\n/// - The bead has made progress but exceeded its time budget\n/// - The work can be meaningfully split into discrete phases\n/// - Child beads can complete the work with the same or reduced timeout\n///\n/// **Use `OrdinaryFailure` mode when:**\n/// - Exit codes 1-123, 125-128 (failure codes) or 127 (agent not found)\n/// - Exit codes >128 (signal crashes)\n/// - Negative exit codes (abnormal termination)\n/// - The failure is NOT time-related and splitting won't help\n///\n/// # API boundary\n///\n/// This enum is the sole discriminator for whether the decomposition path is\n/// activated. No other code should check timeout status or exit codes to make\n/// this decision — all decomposition logic should route through this enum.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum DecompositionMode {\n    /// Timeout-driven decomposition mode.\n    ///\n    /// Contains timeout-specific context for use in generating child bead\n    /// proposals (e.g., original timeout value, elapsed time, progress indicators).\n    Timeout {\n        /// The timeout duration that was exceeded (in seconds).\n        timeout_seconds: u64,\n        /// Optional hint about what phase was being worked on when timeout occurred.\n        /// This can be used to name the first child bead (e.g., \"Phase 1: Routing Rules\").\n        current_phase_hint: Option<String>,\n    },\n    /// Ordinary failure mode — no decomposition.\n    ///\n    /// Used for all non-timeout failures where splitting the bead into child\n    /// beads would not help. The bead should be retried, released, or escalated\n    /// via the normal failure-handling path.\n    OrdinaryFailure,\n}\n\nimpl DecompositionMode {\n    /// Returns true if this is timeout decomposition mode.\n    ///\n    /// This is the primary query method for routing to the decomposition path.\n    /// All code that needs to know whether to decompose should call this method\n    /// rather than inspecting the enum directly.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```\n    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: Some(\"Phase 1\".to_string()),\n    /// };\n    /// assert!(mode.is_timeout());\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n    /// assert!(!mode.is_timeout());\n    /// ```\n    pub fn is_timeout(&self) -> bool {\n        matches!(self, DecompositionMode::Timeout { .. })\n    }\n\n    /// Returns true if this is ordinary failure mode.\n    ///\n    /// This is the primary query method for routing to the normal failure\n    /// handling path (retry, release, or escalate without decomposition).\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```\n    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n    /// assert!(mode.is_ordinary_failure());\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n    /// };\n    /// assert!(!mode.is_ordinary_failure());\n    /// ```\n    pub fn is_ordinary_failure(&self) -> bool {\n        matches!(self, DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the timeout duration if in timeout mode, None otherwise.\n    ///\n    /// This is a convenience method for extracting the timeout value without\n    /// pattern matching. Returns `None` for `OrdinaryFailure` mode.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```\n    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n    /// };\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.timeout_seconds(), Some(120));\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.timeout_seconds(), None);\n    /// ```\n    pub fn timeout_seconds(&self) -> Option<u64> {\n        match self {\n            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n                timeout_seconds, ..\n            } => Some(*timeout_seconds),\n            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the current phase hint if in timeout mode, None otherwise.\n    ///\n    /// This is a convenience method for extracting the optional phase hint\n    /// without pattern matching. Returns `None` for `OrdinaryFailure` mode\n    /// or when the hint is not set.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```\n    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: Some(\"Phase 1\".to_string()),\n    /// };\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.current_phase_hint(), Some(&\"Phase 1\".to_string()));\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n    /// };\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.current_phase_hint(), None);\n    /// ```\n    pub fn current_phase_hint(&self) -> Option<&String> {\n        match self {\n            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n                current_phase_hint, ..\n            } => current_phase_hint.as_ref(),\n            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for DecompositionMode {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n                timeout_seconds, ..\n            } => write!(f, \"timeout ({}s)\", timeout_seconds),\n            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => write!(f, \"ordinary_failure\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// StrandError / StrandResult\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Error returned by a strand evaluation.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StrandError {\n    StoreError(anyhow::Error),\n    ConfigError(String),\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for StrandError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StrandError::StoreError(e) => {\n                // Show the full error chain, not just the top-level context.\n                // This surfaces the actual stderr/stdout from bf/br commands.\n                write!(f, \"bead store error: {}\", e)?;\n                // Append any error causes from the chain (the actual bf/br stderr)\n                for cause in e.chain().skip(1) {\n                    write!(f, \"\\n  caused by: {}\", cause)?;\n                }\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            StrandError::ConfigError(s) => write!(f, \"strand configuration error: {}\", s),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for StrandError {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        match self {\n            StrandError::StoreError(e) => Some(e.as_ref()),\n            StrandError::ConfigError(_) => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Result of a strand evaluation in the waterfall.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StrandResult {\n    /// One or more candidate beads were found.\n    BeadFound(Vec<Bead>),\n    /// The strand synthesized new work (e.g., mitosis created child beads).\n    WorkCreated,\n    /// This strand found nothing; continue to the next strand.\n    NoWork,\n    /// The strand encountered an error during evaluation.\n    Error(StrandError),\n    /// The strand was skipped because its prerequisites are not met.\n    ///\n    /// This is distinct from `NoWork` (which means \"ran and found nothing\")\n    /// and `Error` (which means \"ran but failed\"). `Skipped` means \"did not\n    /// run because the environment doesn't support it\" — e.g., a strand that\n    /// requires a home  /// This signals the worker to use short retry backoff instead of long idle.\n    FoundButExcluded,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ClaimResult / ClaimOutcome\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Result of a single claim attempt for one bead.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum ClaimResult {\n    /// This worker successfully claimed the bead.\n    Claimed(Bead),\n    /// Another worker claimed the bead first.\n    RaceLost {\n        /// Assignee that won ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// NeedleError\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Top-level for NeedleError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            NeedleError::Transient {\n                message,\n                bead_id: bead_id: None,\n            } => {\n                write!(f, \"transient error: {}\", message)\n            }\n            NeedleError::BeadScoped { message, bead_id } => {\n                write!(f, \"bead-scoped error (bead {}): {}\", bead_id, message)\n            }\n            NeedleError::WorkerScoped { message, worker_id } => {\n                write!(f, \"worker-scoped error (worker {}): {}\", worker_id, message)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for NeedleError {}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(100, false), Outcome::Failure); // NOT timeout per spec\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(123, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        // 125-126 -> Failure (not AgentNotFound per spec)\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(125, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(126, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        // >128 -> Crash (signal exits)\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(128, false), Outcome::Failure); // 128 is NOT >128 per spec\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(129, false), Outcome::Crash(129));\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(130, false), Outcome::Crash(130)); // SIGINT -> Crash\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(137, false), Outcome::Crash(137)); // SIGKILL\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(143, false), Outcome::Crash(143)); // SIGTERM -> Crash\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(255, false), Outcome::Crash(255));\n        // negative -> Crash\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(-1, false), Outcome::Crash(-1));\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(-9, false), Outcome::Crash(-9));\n        // Large positive values >255 -> Crash per spec (exit > 128)\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(256, false), Outcome::Crash(256));\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(1000, false), Outcome::Crash(1000));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn outcome_classify_interrupted_flag() {\n        // was_interrupted=true always returns Interrupted, regardless of exit code\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(0, true), Outcome::Interrupted);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(1, true), Outcome::Interrupted);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(127, true), Outcome::Interrupted);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(-1, true), Outcome::Interrupted);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(137, true), Outcome::Interrupted);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn outcome_as_str() {\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::Success.as_str(),    }\n782\t        }\n783\t\n784\t        Ok(())\n785\t    }\n786\t\n787\t    // ── Step 4: Agent log file cleanup ──────────────────────────────────────\n788\t\n789\t    /// Delete `.agent.jsonl`
