The type system enforces\n//! exhaustiveness — if an outcome can happen, it must have a handler.\n//!\n//! Depends on: `types`, `config`, `bead_store`, `telemetry`, `validation`.\n\nuse std::fmt;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::Utc;\n\nuse crate::bead_store::{BeadStore, SyncRecoveryError};\nuse crate::config::Config;\nuse crate::telemetry::{EventKind, Telemetry};\n#[cfg(test)]\nuse crate::types::BeadStatus;\nuse crate::types::{AgentOutcome, Bead, BeadAction, HandlerResult, Outcome};\nuse crate::validation::{verify_shipped_work, GateConfig, GateReport, ValidationGate};\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// classify (convenience re-export)\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Classify an agent exit code into an `Outcome`, with shutdown signal support.\n///\n/// Delegates to `Outcome::classify()`. Provided here for ergonomic imports.\npub fn classify(exit_code: i32, was_interrupted: bool) -> Outcome {\n    Outcome::classify(exit_code, was_interrupted)\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// OutcomeHandler\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Routes agent outcomes to their explicit handlers.\npub struct OutcomeHandler {\n    config: Config,\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n}\n\nimpl OutcomeHandler {\n    pub fn new(config: Config, telemetry: Telemetry) -> Self {\n        OutcomeHandler { config, telemetry }\n    }\n\n    /// Run a bead store operation with a 30s timeout.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(Some(T))` on success, `Ok(None)` on timeout, and `Err(E)` on\n    /// other errors. Callers should treat timeout and error as non-fatal — log\n    /// and continue rather than blocking the worker in HANDLING state.\n    async fn timeout_op<T, F, Fut>(\n        &self,\n        op: F,\n        operation_name: &str,\n    ) -> Result<Option<T>, anyhow::Error>\n    where\n        F: FnOnce() -> Fut,\n        Fut: std::future::Future<Output = Result<T, anyhow::Error>>,\n    {\n        match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), op()).await {\n            Ok(Ok(result)) => Ok(Some(result)),\n            Ok(Err(e)) => Err(e),\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::error!(\n                    operation = operation_name,\n                    \"bead store operation timed out after 30s\"\n                );\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Release a bead with sync conflict recovery and graceful failure handling.\n    ///\n    /// Flow:\n    /// 1. Run `br sync --flush-only` to push local writes to JSONL first.\n    /// 2. Attempt `br update` to release the bead (set status=open, assignee=\"\").\n    /// 3. If SYNC_CONFLICT recovery fails, emit `BeadReleaseFailed` and return Ok.\n    ///\n    /// This method never returns an error — release failures are non-fatal.\n    /// The worker can continue processing other beads even if release fails.\n    async fn release_bead(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead: &Bead) -> Result<Vec<EventKind>> {\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Step 1: Flush local writes to JSONL before attempting release.\n        // Emit heartbeat before br call to track where hang occurs.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {\n            bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),\n            state: \"HANDLING_FLUSH\".to_string(),\n        });\n\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.flush(), \"flush\").await {\n            Ok(Some(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"flushed local changes to JSONL before release\"\n                );\n                // Emit heartbeat after successful flush.\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {\n                    bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),\n                    state: \"HANDLING_FLUSH_DONE\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"flush timed out before release, attempting release anyway\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"release\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"flush\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"flush failed before release, attempting release anyway\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"release\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"flush\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Step 2: Attempt release with timeout protection.\n        // Emit heartbeat before br release call to track where hang occurs.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {\n            bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),\n            state: \"HANDLING_RELEASE\".to_string(),\n        });\n\n        let release_result =\n            tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.release(&bead.id)).await;\n\n        match release_result {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"bead released successfully\"\n                );\n                // Emit heartbeat after successful release.\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {\n                    bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),\n                    state: \"HANDLING_RELEASE_DONE\".to_string(),\n                });\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadReleased {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    reason: \"release_success\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                // Release failed (br error, not timeout).\n                // Check if this is a SyncRecoveryError (sync recovery was attempted but failed).\n                if e.downcast_ref::<SyncRecoveryError>().is_some() {\n                    tracing::error!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"br release failed after SYNC_CONFLICT recovery — \\\n                         worker will continue (bead may remain assigned)\"\n                    );\n                } else {\n                    tracing::error!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"br release failed — worker will continue (bead may remain assigned)\"\n                    );\n                }\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    reason: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Timeout after 30s.\n                tracing::error!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"br release timed out after 30s — worker will continue (bead may remain assigned)\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    reason: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a process output for the given bead.\n    ///\n    /// Uses `classify()` to determine the outcome, then dispatches to the\n    /// per-outcome handler. Every `Outcome` variant has an explicit arm —\n    /// no wildcards. Returns a `HandlerResult` describing what happened.\n    #[tracing::instrument(\n        name = \"bead.outcome\",\n        skip(self, store, bead, output),\n        fields(\n            needle.bead.id = %bead.id,\n            needle.outcome = tracing::field::Empty,\n            needle.outcome.action = tracing::field::Empty,\n        )\n    )]\n    pub async fn handle(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        output: &AgentOutcome,\n        was_interrupted: bool,\n    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {\n        let outcome = classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted);\n\n        // Set outcome as span attribute\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.outcome\", outcome.as_str());\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            exit_code = output.exit_code,\n            outcome = %outcome,\n            \"handling agent outcome\"\n        );\n\n        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.\n        // This prevents worker hang in HANDLING state when telemetry is wedged.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::OutcomeClassified {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            outcome: outcome.as_str().to_string(),\n            exit_code: output.exit_code,\n        });\n\n        let (bead_action, telemetry_events) = match outcome.clone() {\n            Outcome::Success => self.handle_success(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Failure => self.handle_failure(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Timeout => self.handle_timeout(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::AgentNotFound => self.handle_agent_not_found(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Interrupted => self.handle_interrupted(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Crash(code) => self.handle_crash(store, bead, code).await?,\n        };\n\n        // Emit sub-handler events (e.g. BeadCompleted, BeadOrphaned) to the\n        // telemetry sink so they appear in the JSONL log.\n        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.\n        for event in &telemetry_events {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(event.clone());\n        }\n\n        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::OutcomeHandled {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            outcome: outcome.as_str().to_string(),\n            action: bead_action.to_string(),\n        });\n\n        // Set action as span attribute\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.outcome.action\", bead_action.to_string());\n\n        // Set span status: Ok for success, Error otherwise\n        if !matches!(outcome, Outcome::Success) {\n            tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n            tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", outcome.as_str());\n        }\n\n        Ok(HandlerResult {\n            outcome,\n            bead_action,\n            telemetry_events,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a process output with cancellation support.\n    ///\n    /// Checks the cancellation flag before starting the handler and returns\n    /// early if the handler has been cancelled (e.g., due to a timeout in\n    /// the worker). This prevents the handler from making further br calls\n    /// after a timeout has occurred.\n    pub async fn handle_with_cancellation(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        output: &AgentOutcome,\n        was_interrupted: bool,\n        cancelled: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {\n        // Check if we've been cancelled before starting.\n        if cancelled.load(Ordering::Acquire) {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                \"outcome handler cancelled before starting, returning early\"\n            );\n            // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.\n            return Ok(HandlerResult {\n                outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted),\n                bead_action: BeadAction::None,\n                telemetry_events: vec![],\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Wrap the handler in a timeout to prevent indefinite hangs.\n        // This is a safety net in case the internal br call timeouts don't work.\n        // Configurable via `validation.outcome_timeout_seconds` (default 50) —\n        // see GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#8: a gate running a real verification\n        // workload (container test suite, secret scan, fresh-model diff verifier)\n        // needs minutes, not seconds.\n        let bead_id = bead.id.clone();\n        let telemetry = self.telemetry.clone();\n        let timeout_secs = self.config.validation.outcome_timeout_seconds;\n\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs),\n            self.handle(store, bead, output, was_interrupted),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(result)) => Ok(result),\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                // Handler returned an error.\n                tracing::error!(\n                    bead_id = %bead_id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"outcome handler returned error\"\n                );\n                Err(e)\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Timeout after `timeout_secs` seconds.\n                tracing::error!(\n                    bead_id = %bead_id,\n                    timeout_secs,\n                    \"outcome handler timed out, returning early to allow worker recovery\"\n                );\n                // Emit a timeout event for observability.\n                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted)\n                        .as_str()\n                        .to_string(),\n                    operation: \"handle\".to_string(),\n                    error: format!(\"timeout after {}s\", timeout_secs),\n                });\n                // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.\n                // The worker's 60-second timeout wrapper will handle best-effort release.\n                Ok(HandlerResult {\n                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted),\n                    bead_action: BeadAction::Released,\n                    telemetry_events: vec![EventKind::BeadReleased {\n                        bead_id,\n                        reason: \"handler_timeout\".to_string(),\n                    }],\n                })\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Success: run validation gates (if configured), then verify bead closure.\n    ///\n    /// Flow:\n    /// 1. If validation gates are configured (new or legacy format), run them.\n    /// 2. If any gate fails: reopen the bead (if agent closed it) and release it.\n    /// 3. If all gates pass (or none configured): check if agent closed the bead.\n    ///    - Closed → emit BeadCompleted.\n    ///    - Still open → emit BeadOrphaned warning.\n    ///\n    /// NEEDLE does NOT auto-close — the agent owns closure via `br close`.\n    async fn handle_success(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent completed successfully\");\n\n        // Try pluggable gates first, fall back to legacy verification commands.\n        let gate = if !self.config.gates.is_empty() {\n            // New pluggable gate system. Fill in each command gate's stderr\n            // cap from `validation.stderr_cap_bytes` unless the gate already\n            // set its own override — see GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#9.\n            let default_stderr_cap = self.config.validation.stderr_cap_bytes;\n            let gate_configs: Vec<(String, GateConfig)> = self\n                .config\n                .gates\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, config)| {\n                    let mut config = config.clone();\n                    let GateConfig::Command {\n                        stderr_cap_bytes, ..\n                    } = &mut config;\n                    if stderr_cap_bytes.is_none() {\n                        *stderr_cap_bytes = Some(default_stderr_cap);\n                    }\n                    (format!(\"gate_{}\", i), config)\n                })\n                .collect();\n            ValidationGate::new(gate_configs, bead.workspace.clone())\n        } else if !self.config.verification.is_empty() {\n            // Legacy verification command format.\n            ValidationGate::from_commands_with_stderr_cap(\n                self.config.verification.clone(),\n                bead.workspace.clone(),\n                self.config.validation.stderr_cap_bytes,\n            )\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        if let Some(gate) = gate {\n            let report = gate.run(bead).await?;\n\n            if !report.all_passed {\n                return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;\n            }\n\n            // All gates passed — emit telemetry.\n            let gates_run = report.results.len() as u32;\n            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationPassed {\n                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                gates_run,\n            })?;\n            tracing::info!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                gates_run,\n                \"all validation gates passed\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Reset failure count on successful gate completion.\n        // This ensures the bead starts fresh on the next cycle if re-claimed.\n        let _ = self.reset_failure_count(store, bead).await;\n\n        // Normal success flow: check if agent closed the bead.\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Use timeout for show() to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), \"show\").await {\n            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {\n                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {\n                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {\n                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                reason = %reason,\n                                \"bead closed but shipped-work check failed — reopening and releasing\"\n                            );\n                            let report = GateReport::single_failure(\"shipped_work\", reason);\n                            return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;\n                        }\n                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {}\n                        Err(e) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"shipped-work check errored — failing open\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // Dispatch is fully accounted for — drop its snapshot so the\n                // next claim of this bead starts from a fresh baseline.\n                crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;\n\n                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"bead confirmed closed by agent\");\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    duration_ms: 0,\n                });\n                // Increment success_count for any skills that matched this bead.\n                if !bead.workspace.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n                    if let Ok(lib) = crate::skill::SkillLibrary::load(&bead.workspace) {\n                        if let Err(e) = lib.increment_success_for_bead(&bead.labels, &bead.title) {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to increment skill success counts\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(Some(current)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    status = %current.status,\n                    \"agent exited successfully but bead is still open (orphaned)\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadOrphaned {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                });\n\n                // Use verify_shipped_work to decide close-vs-release.\n                // If the agent shipped work, close the bead. Otherwise, release\n                // and increment failure count so repeat offenders quarantine.\n                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {\n                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {\n                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {\n                            tracing::info!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                \"shipped work detected — closing orphaned bead\"\n                            );\n                            // Close the bead to finish what the agent started.\n                            let _ = tokio::time::timeout(\n                                std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                                store.close(&bead.id, \"shipped work detected (agent did not close)\"),\n                            )\n                            .await;\n                            // Clear the predispatch snapshot since work is complete.\n                            crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;\n                            events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {\n                                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                                duration_ms: 0,\n                            });\n                        }\n                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                reason = %reason,\n                                \"no shipped work detected — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment\"\n                            );\n                            // Release and increment failure count to apply quarantine.\n                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n                            events.append(&mut release_events);\n                            let release_succeeded = events\n                                .iter()\n                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n                            if release_succeeded {\n                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;\n                            }\n                        }\n                        Err(e) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"shipped-work check errored — releasing orphaned bead with failure increment\"\n                            );\n                            // On error, release and increment failure count.\n                            let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n                            events.append(&mut release_events);\n                            let release_succeeded = events\n                                .iter()\n                                .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n                            if release_succeeded {\n                                let _ = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await;\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        \"enforce_shipped_work disabled — releasing orphaned bead\"\n                    );\n                    // If enforce_shipped_work is disabled, just release without closing.\n                    let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n                    events.append(&mut release_events);\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                // Timeout - emit telemetry and continue.\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"show() timed out, could not verify bead closure status\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"success\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"show\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"could not verify bead closure status\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"success\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"show\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Flush SQLite state to JSONL so the closed/orphaned bead is captured in\n        // the git-committed backup. Non-fatal: a flush failure is logged but does\n        // not block the worker from picking up the next bead.\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.flush(), \"flush\").await {\n            Ok(Some(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"flushed bead state to JSONL after success\");\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"flush timed out after success — JSONL may lag SQLite\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, error = %e, \"flush failed after success — JSONL may lag SQLite\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok((BeadAction::None, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Handle gate failure: reopen the bead if it was closed, then release it.\n    async fn handle_gate_failure(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        report: &crate::validation::GateReport,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        // Find the first failing gate for telemetry.\n        let (failed_gate, reason) = report\n            .results\n            .iter()\n            .find(|(_, r)| !r.passed())\n            .map(|(name, r)| (name.clone(), r.failure_reason().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string()))\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| (\"unknown\".to_string(), \"unknown error\".to_string()));\n\n        tracing::warn!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            gate = %failed_gate,\n            reason = %reason,\n            \"validation gate failed — releasing bead\"\n        );\n\n        // Emit verification failure telemetry.\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationFailed {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            command: failed_gate.clone(),\n            exit_code: None,\n            output: reason,\n        })?;\n\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // If the agent already closed the bead, reopen it before releasing.\n        // Use timeout to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), \"show\").await {\n            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"reopening bead closed by agent (verification failed)\"\n                );\n                match self.timeout_op(|| store.reopen(&bead.id), \"reopen\").await {\n                    Ok(_) => {}\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to reopen bead — attempting release anyway\"\n                        );\n                        events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                            outcome: \"gate_failure\".to_string(),\n                            operation: \"reopen\".to_string(),\n                            error: e.to_string(),\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"show() timed out during gate failure handling, skipping reopen\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"gate_failure\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"show\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"show() failed during gate failure handling\"\n                );\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n\n        // Release the bead back to open with flush-before-release and sync recovery.\n        let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n        events.append(&mut release_events);\n\n        // If release succeeded, increment the failure count and apply the same\n        // quarantine ceiling `handle_failure` uses. Without this, a bead that\n        // fails a gate every cycle is released back to open forever: the\n        // ARMOR/bf-135k storm ran one bead 24 times in a single day, each\n        // attempt leaving another commit behind. A gate failure is no less\n        // repeatable than an agent failure and must respect the same ceiling.\n        let release_succeeded = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;\n        if release_succeeded {\n            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {\n                Ok(new_count) => {\n                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;\n                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {\n                        match self\n                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)\n                            .await\n                        {\n                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {\n                                events.extend(quarantine_events);\n                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;\n                            }\n                            Err(e) => {\n                                tracing::warn!(\n                                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                    error = %e,\n                                    \"failed to quarantine bead after exceeding gate-failure threshold\"\n                                );\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to increment failure count after gate failure\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Add a label indicating verification failure.\n        if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.add_label(&bead.id, \"verification-failed\"),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                error = %e,\n                \"failed to add verification-failed label\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok((action, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Failure: release bead and increment failure count.\n    ///\n    /// Mitosis evaluation (for multi-task splitting) is handled externally by\n    /// the worker after outcome handling — see `MitosisEvaluator`.\n    ///\n    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not\n    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.\n    async fn handle_failure(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent failure — releasing bead\");\n\n        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n\n        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and check the\n        // quarantine threshold. A bead that has exceeded\n        // `outcome.quarantine_after_failures` consecutive failures is\n        // quarantined (status=blocked) instead of being left released-to-open\n        // for the next cycle to re-claim and fail again indefinitely. This\n        // also closes the mitosis `NotSplittable` fallthrough (worker/mod.rs):\n        // that verdict no longer matters for beads at or past the ceiling,\n        // since this check already ran before mitosis evaluation this cycle.\n        let release_succeeded = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;\n        if release_succeeded {\n            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {\n                Ok(new_count) => {\n                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;\n                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {\n                        match self\n                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)\n                            .await\n                        {\n                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {\n                                events.extend(quarantine_events);\n                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;\n                            }\n                            Err(e) => {\n                                tracing::warn!(\n                                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                    error = %e,\n                                    \"failed to quarantine bead after exceeding failure threshold\"\n                                );\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to increment failure count after release\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Ensure we emit a reason event for telemetry.\n        if !events.iter().any(|e| {\n            matches!(\n                e,\n                EventKind::BeadReleased { .. } | EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { .. }\n            )\n        }) {\n            events.push(EventKind::BeadReleased {\n                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                reason: \"failure\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        Ok((action, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Timeout: release bead and add `deferred` label.\n    ///\n    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not\n    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.\n    async fn handle_timeout(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent timed out — releasing bead as deferred\");\n\n        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n\n        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and add deferred label.\n        let release_succeeded = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n        if release_succeeded {\n            // Increment failure count for auto-split tracking.\n            if let Err(e) = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to increment failure count after timeout\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(\n                std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                store.add_label(&bead.id, \"deferred\"),\n            )\n            .await\n            {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"add_label deferred timed out or failed after timeout release\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"timeout\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"add_label\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok((BeadAction::Deferred, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Crash: release bead and create alert bead with diagnostic info.\n    async fn handle_crash(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        signal_code: i32,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::error!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            signal_code,\n            agent = %self.config.agent.default,\n            \"agent crashed — releasing bead and creating alert\"\n        );\n\n        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n\n        // Create alert bead with diagnostic info (best-effort).\n        let signal_num = if signal_code > 128 {\n            signal_code - 128\n        } else {\n            signal_code\n        };\n        let timestamp = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n        let alert_title = format!(\"ALERT: Agent crash on bead {}\", bead.id);\n        let alert_body = format!(\n            \"## Agent Crash Report\\n\\\n             \\n\\\n             - **Bead ID**: {}\\n\\\n             - **Agent**: {}\\n\\\n             - **Exit code**: {} (signal {})\\n\\\n             - **Workspace**: {}\\n\\\n             - **Timestamp**: {}\\n\\\n             \\n\\\n             The agent process was killed. This bead has been released for retry.\",\n            bead.id,\n            self.config.agent.default,\n            signal_code,\n            signal_num,\n            bead.workspace.display(),\n            timestamp,\n        );\n\n        // Hook 4: propagate stitch labels from the crashed bead to the alert.\n        let signal_label = format!(\"signal-{}\", signal_num);\n        let mut alert_labels: Vec<String> = vec![\"alert\".into(), \"crash\".into(), signal_label];\n        alert_labels.extend(crate::types::extract_stitch_labels(&bead.labels));\n        let alert_label_refs: Vec<&str> = alert_labels.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.create_bead(&alert_title, &alert_body, &alert_label_refs),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(alert_id)) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    %alert_id,\n                    \"crash alert bead created\"\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to create crash alert bead\"\n                );\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"create_bead timed out after 30s during crash handling\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok((BeadAction::Alerted, events))\n    }\n\n    /// AgentNotFound: release bead, emit error. No retry — this is a config issue.\n    async fn handle_agent_not_found(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::error!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            agent = %self.config.agent.default,\n            \"agent binary not found — releasing bead (config issue, no retry)\"\n        );\n\n        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n        Ok((BeadAction::Released, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Interrupted: release bead for graceful shutdown.\n    async fn handle_interrupted(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent interrupted — releasing bead for clean shutdown\");\n\n        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n        Ok((BeadAction::Released, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Increment the failure count label on a bead.\n    ///\n    /// Labels follow the pattern `failure-count:N`. If `failure-count:2` exists,\n    /// the old label is removed and `failure-count:3` is added.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the new failure count (or 0 if the operation failed).\n    ///\n    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in\n    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.\n    async fn increment_failure_count(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead: &Bead) -> Result<u32> {\n        // Read labels with timeout.\n        let labels =\n            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(&bead.id))\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(Ok(l)) => l,\n                Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"could not read labels to increment failure count\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        \"labels() timed out after 30s, skipping failure count increment\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n            };\n\n        let current_count = labels\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"failure-count:\"))\n            .filter_map(|n| n.parse::<u32>().ok())\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n\n        let new_count = current_count + 1;\n        let new_label = format!(\"failure-count:{}\", new_count);\n\n        // Remove old failure-count labels before adding the new one.\n        // Each remove_label call is wrapped in a timeout.\n        for label in &labels {\n            if label.starts_with(\"failure-count:\") {\n                match tokio::time::timeout(\n                    std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                    store.remove_label(&bead.id, label),\n                )\n                .await\n                {\n                    Ok(Ok(())) => {}\n                    Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to remove old failure-count label\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            \"remove_label timed out after 30s\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Add the new label with timeout.\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.add_label(&bead.id, &new_label),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    count = new_count,\n                    \"failure count incremented\"\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to add failure-count label\"\n                );\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"add_label timed out after 30s\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(new_count)\n    }\n\n    /// Reset the failure count label on a bead by removing all `failure-count:N` labels.\n    ///\n    /// Called on success to clear the failure counter so the bead starts fresh\n    /// on the next cycle.\n    ///\n    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in\n    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.\n    async fn reset_failure_count(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead: &Bead) -> Result<()> {\n        // Read labels with timeout.\n        let labels =\n            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(&bead.id))\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(Ok(l)) => l,\n                Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"could not read labels to reset failure count\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        \"labels() timed out after 30s, skipping failure count reset\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n            };\n\n        // Remove all failure-count labels.\n        let mut removed_count = 0;\n        for label in &labels {\n            if label.starts_with(\"failure-count:\") {\n                match tokio::time::timeout(\n                    std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                    store.remove_label(&bead.id, label),\n                )\n                .await\n                {\n                    Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                        removed_count += 1;\n                    }\n                    Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to remove failure-count label\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            \"remove_label timed out after 30s\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if removed_count > 0 {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                removed_count,\n                \"failure count reset\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Quarantine a bead by setting status=blocked and adding the 'cycling' label.\n    ///\n    /// This is called when a bead exceeds the configured failure threshold.\n    /// Emits a BeadQuarantined telemetry event.\n    ///\n    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in\n    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.\n    async fn quarantine_bead(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        failure_count: u32,\n        threshold: u32,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<EventKind>> {\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        tracing::warn!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            failure_count,\n            threshold,\n            \"quarantining bead after exceeding failure threshold\"\n        );\n\n        // Set status=blocked with timeout. This is what actually stops Pluck\n        // from re-selecting the bead — the 'cycling' label below is a\n        // human-facing marker, not the enforcement mechanism.\n        match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.block(&bead.id)).await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"set status=blocked\");\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to set status=blocked during quarantine\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"block\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"block timed out after 30s during quarantine\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"block\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Add the 'cycling' label with timeout.\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.add_label(&bead.id, \"cycling\"),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"added 'cycling' label\"\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to add 'cycling' label\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"add_label\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"add_label timed out after 30s\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"add_label\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Emit the BeadQuarantined event.\n        events.push(EventKind::BeadQuarantined {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            failure_count,\n            threshold,\n        });\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Outcome Display\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nimpl fmt::Display for Outcome {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Outcome::Success => write!(f, \"Success\"),\n            Outcome::Failure => write!(f, \"Failure\"),\n            Outcome::Timeout => write!(f, \"Timeout\"),\n            Outcome::AgentNotFound => write!(f, \"AgentNotFound\"),\n            Outcome::Interrupted => write!(f, \"Interrupted\"),\n            Outcome::Crash(code) => write!(f, \"Crash({})\", code),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// AtomicUsize,\n    /// Count of beads excluded during the most recent evaluation.\n    last_excluded_count: AtomicUsize,\n    /// Aggregated exclusion reasons from the most recent evaluation.\n    /// Uses Mutex for thread-safe interior mutability.\n    last_exclusion_reasons: Mutex<Vec<String>>,\n}\n\nimpl PluckStrand {\n    /// Create a new PluckStrand with the given exclude labels and telemetry.\n    ///\n    /// If `exclude_labels` is empty, the default set (`deferred`, `human`,\n    /// `blocked`) is used.\n    pub fn new(exclude_labels: Vec<String>, telemetry: Telemetry) -> Self {\n        let labels = if exclude_labels.is_empty() {\n            DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_LABELS\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| (*s).to_string())\n                .collect()\n        } else {\n            exclude_labels\n        };\n        PluckStrand {\n            exclude_labels: labels,\n            split_after_failures: 3, // default threshold\n            telemetry,\n            needle_workspace: None,\n            persistent_starvation_records: false,\n            last_open_count: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n            last_excluded_count: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n            last_exclusion_reasons: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new PluckStrand with the given exclude labels, split threshold, and telemetry.\n    ///\n    /// If `exclude_labels` is empty, the default set (`deferred`, `human`,\n    /// `blocked`) is used.\n    pub fn with_split_threshold(\n        exclude_labels: Vec<String>,\n        split_after_failures: u32,\n        telemetry: Telemetry,\n    ) -> Self {\n        let labels = if exclude_labels.is_empty() {\n            DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_LABELS\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| (*s).to_string())\n                .collect()\n        } else {\n            exclude_labels\n        };\n        PluckStrand {\n            exclude_labels: labels,\n            split_after_failures,\n            telemetry,\n            needle_workspace: None,\n            persistent_starvation_records: false,\n            last_open_count: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n            last_excluded_count: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n            last_exclusion_reasons: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new PluckStrand with persistent starvation records enabled.\n    ///\n    /// When `persistent_starvation_records` is true, starvation events are\n    /// written to `needle_workspace/state/starvation-records.jsonl`.\n    /// Records are never written to target workspaces, only to NEEDLE workspace.\n    pub fn with_persistent_records(\n        exclude_labels: Vec<String>,\n        split_after_failures: u32,\n        telemetry: Telemetry,\n        needle_workspace: PathBuf,\n        persistent_starvation_records: bool,\n    ) -> Self {\n        let labels = if exclude_labels.is_empty() {\n            DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_LABELS\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| (*s).to_string())\n                .collect()\n        } else {\n            exclude_labels\n        };\n        PluckStrand {\n            exclude_labels: labels,\n            split_after_failures,\n            telemetry,\n            needle_workspace: Some(needle_workspace),\n            persistent_starvation_records,\n            last_open_count: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n            last_excluded_count: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n            last_exclusion_reasons: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Extract the failure count from a bead's labels.\n    ///\n    /// Labels follow the pattern `failure-count:N`. Returns the count if found,\n    /// or 0 if no failure-count label exists.\n    fn extract_failure_count(bead: &Bead) -> u32 {\n        bead.labels\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"failure-count:\"))\n            .filter_map(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0)\n    }\n\n    /// Sort candidates in deterministic priority order.\n    ///\n    /// Sort key: `(priority ASC, failure_count ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC)`.\n    ///\n    /// `failure_count` sits ahead of `created_at` deliberately: without it, a\n    /// bead that keeps failing is (by construction) always at least as old as\n    /// its ready siblings, so it sorts to slot 1 every single cycle and the\n    /// worker never even tries the other ready work sitting behind it. This\n    /// does not by itself stop the retry loop — `split_after_failures` /\n    /// `OutcomeConfig::quarantine_after_failures` own that — it just stops a\n    /// struggling bead from starving healthier ready beads at the same\n    /// priority while it climbs toward the quarantine threshold.\n    /// The id tie-breaker ensures identical ordering across platforms.\n    fn sort_candidates(candidates: &mut [Bead]) {\n        candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n            a.priority\n                .cmp(&b.priority)\n                .then_with(|| Self::extract_failure_count(a).cmp(&Self::extract_failure_count(b)))\n                .then_with(|| a.created_at.cmp(&b.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| a.id.as_ref().cmp(b.id.as_ref()))\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Get the filtering statistics from the most recent evaluation.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `(open_count, excluded_count, exclusion_reasons)` where:\n    /// - `open_count` is the count of beads returned by the store before filtering\n    /// - `excluded_count` is the count of beads excluded during filtering\n    /// - `exclusion_reasons` is a vector of strings describing why each bead was excluded\n    pub fn last_filtering_stats(&self) -> (usize, usize, Vec<String>) {\n        (\n            self.last_open_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed),\n            self.last_excluded_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed),\n            self.last_exclusion_reasons.lock().unwrap().clone(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Write a persistent starvation record to NEEDLE workspace.\n    ///\n    /// Records are written in JSONL format to `~/.needle/state/starvation-records.jsonl`.\n    /// This method is called only when `persistent_starvation_records` is enabled.\n    fn write_starvation_record(\n        &self,\n        target_workspace: &str,\n        open_count: usize,\n        excluded_count: usize,\n        exclusion_reasons: &[String],\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let needle_home = self\n            .needle_workspace\n            .as_ref()\n            .context(\"needle_workspace not set - cannot write persistent record\")?;\n\n        // Create state directory if it doesn't exist\n        let state_dir = needle_home.join(\"state\");\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&state_dir).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\"failed to create state directory: {}\", state_dir.display())\n        })?;\n\n        // Write record to starvation-records.jsonl (append mode)\n        let record_path = state_dir.join(\"starvation-records.jsonl\");\n        let record = StarvationRecord {\n            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n            target_workspace: target_workspace.to_string(),\n            open_count,\n            excluded_count,\n            exclusion_reasons: exclusion_reasons.to_vec(),\n        };\n\n        // Serialize to JSON and append to file\n        let record_json =\n            serde_json::to_string(&record).context(\"failed to serialize starvation record\")?;\n\n        let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&record_path)\n            .with_context(|| {\n                format!(\n                    \"failed to open starvation records file: {}\",\n                    record_path.display()\n                )\n            })?;\n\n        use std::io::Write;\n        writeln!(file, \"{}\", record_json).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\n                \"failed to write starvation record to: {}\",\n                record_path.display()\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            record_path = %record_path.display(),\n            target_workspace = %target_workspace,\n            \"Wrote persistent starvation record\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for PluckStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"pluck\"\n    }\n\n    #[tracing::instrument(\n        name = \"strand.pluck\",\n        skip(self, store),\n        fields(\n            strand = \"pluck\",\n            exclude_labels = ?self.exclude_labels,\n            split_threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n        )\n    )]\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult {\n        tracing::debug!(\n            exclude_labels = ?self.exclude_labels,\n            split_threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n            \"Pluck strand evaluation starting\"\n        );\n\n        // Check if the home bead store exists. If not, skip this strand.\n        // This distinguishes between \"no home store configured\" (expected for\n        // roam-only workers) and \"home store is broken\" (unexpected error).\n        if !store.has_valid_store() {\n            tracing::info!(\n                \"Home workspace has no .beads/ directory — skipping Pluck strand \\\n                 (expected for roam-only workers)\"\n            );\n            return StrandResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"no_home_store\".to_string(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        // 1. Query bead store for ready, unassigned beads.\n        let filters = Filters {\n            assignee: None,\n            exclude_labels: self.exclude_labels.clone(),\n            exclude_ids: HashSet::new(),\n        };\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            filters = ?filters,\n            \"Querying bead store for ready candidates\"\n        );\n\n        // Log the complete query before execution\n        tracing::info!(\n            assignee = ?filters.assignee,\n            exclude_labels = ?filters.exclude_labels,\n            exclude_ids_count = filters.exclude_ids.len(),\n            \"Executing Pluck query with filters\"\n        );\n\n        let mut candidates = match store.ready(&filters).await {\n            Ok(beads) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    count = beads.len(),\n                    \"Bead store returned {} candidates\",\n                    beads.len()\n                );\n                beads\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                // Log the full error chain to capture stderr/exit code details.\n                // The Display impl (%e) only shows the top-level message, losing\n                // the underlying stderr from br/bf commands. Use {:?} or iterate\n                // the chain to preserve diagnostic information.\n                let error_chain: Vec<String> = std::iter::once(format!(\"{}\", e))\n                    .chain(e.chain().map(|cause| format!(\"  caused by: {}\", cause)))\n                    .collect();\n                tracing::error!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    error_chain = ?error_chain,\n                    \"Bead store query failed\"\n                );\n                // Bead store error is semantically different from NoWork.\n                return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Initialize filtering statistics for starvation telemetry.\n        let mut stats = FilteringStats {\n            open_count: candidates.len(),\n            ..Default::default()\n        };\n\n        // 2. Filter: remove beads with excluded labels.\n        //    Defensive guard — store.ready() passes exclude_labels in its Filters,\n        //    but the backing CLI may not include label data in every query type.\n        //    Filtering here guarantees excluded-label beads are never presented as\n        //    candidates regardless of backend behaviour, preventing the\n        //    SELECTING→CLAIMING→RETRYING spin loop observed when br ready --json\n        //    omits label fields for some beads.\n        let before_label_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        // First pass: collect excluded beads and their reasons for telemetry.\n        let excluded_beads: Vec<_> = candidates\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| b.labels.iter().any(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l)))\n            .map(|b| {\n                let excluded_labels: Vec<_> = b\n                    .labels\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l))\n                    .cloned()\n                    .collect();\n                (b.id.as_ref().to_string(), excluded_labels)\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Second pass: perform the actual filtering.\n        candidates.retain(|b| !b.labels.iter().any(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l)));\n        let after_label_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        if before_label_filter != after_label_filter {\n            let label_excluded_count = before_label_filter - after_label_filter;\n            stats.excluded_count += label_excluded_count;\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                excluded_count = label_excluded_count,\n                remaining = after_label_filter,\n                excluded_labels = ?self.exclude_labels,\n                \"Label filtering excluded {} beads\",\n                label_excluded_count\n            );\n\n            // Log each excluded bead at DEBUG level and collect reasons for telemetry.\n            for (id, excluded_labels) in &excluded_beads {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %id,\n                    labels = ?excluded_labels,\n                    \"Excluded bead due to labels\"\n                );\n\n                // Add to exclusion reasons for telemetry.\n                for label in excluded_labels {\n                    stats.exclusion_reasons.push(format!(\"label:{}\", label));\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                count = after_label_filter,\n                \"No beads excluded by label filter\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 3. Filter: remove beads that are actively in_progress (claimed by another worker)\n        //    and Open beads with a stale assignee. These are never claimable — the claimer\n        //    will reject them every time, causing a hot loop.\n        let before_status_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        // First pass: collect excluded beads and their reasons for telemetry.\n        let excluded_by_status: Vec<_> = candidates\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| {\n                matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress)\n                    || (b.status == crate::types::BeadStatus::Open && b.assignee.is_some())\n            })\n            .map(|b| {\n                let reason = if matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress) {\n                    \"status:in_progress\".to_string()\n                } else {\n                    format!(\"assignee:{}\", b.assignee.as_ref().unwrap())\n                };\n                (b.id.as_ref().to_string(), reason)\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Second pass: perform the actual filtering.\n        candidates.retain(|b| {\n            !(matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress)\n                || (b.status == crate::types::BeadStatus::Open && b.assignee.is_some()))\n        });\n        let after_status_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        if before_status_filter != after_status_filter {\n            let status_excluded_count = before_status_filter - after_status_filter;\n            stats.excluded_count += status_excluded_count;\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                filtered_count = status_excluded_count,\n                remaining = after_status_filter,\n                \"Status/assignee filtering removed {} beads\",\n                status_excluded_count\n            );\n\n            // Log each excluded bead at DEBUG level and collect reasons for telemetry.\n            for (id, reason) in &excluded_by_status {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %id,\n                    reason = %reason,\n                    \"Excluded bead due to status/assignee\"\n                );\n\n                // Add to exclusion reasons for telemetry.\n                stats.exclusion_reasons.push(reason.clone());\n            }\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                count = after_status_filter,\n                \"No beads excluded by status/assignee filter\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 4. Sort: deterministic (priority, created_at, id).\n        if !candidates.is_empty() {\n            let first = &candidates[0];\n            tracing::debug!(\n                total = candidates.len(),\n                first_bead_id = %first.id,\n                first_priority = first.priority,\n                first_created_at = %first.created_at,\n                \"Sorting {} candidates by (priority ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC)\",\n                candidates.len()\n            );\n        }\n        Self::sort_candidates(&mut candidates);\n\n        // 5. Check for split trigger: if the first candidate has accumulated\n        //    enough consecutive failures, dispatch a SPLIT instruction instead\n        //    of returning the bead for normal processing.\n        if self.split_after_failures > 0 {\n            if let Some(first_candidate) = candidates.first() {\n                let failure_count = Self::extract_failure_count(first_candidate);\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n                    failure_count = failure_count,\n                    threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n                    split_triggered = failure_count >= self.split_after_failures,\n                    \"Checking split trigger for first candidate\"\n                );\n\n                if failure_count >= self.split_after_failures {\n                    // Check if this bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration.\n                    // Such beads have no legitimate resolution path from inside a target repo\n                    // and should not be split into child beads there.\n                    if detects_needle_internal_config(first_candidate) {\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n                            title = %first_candidate.title,\n                            failure_count = failure_count,\n                            \"Split skipped: bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration, out of scope for target workspace\"\n                        );\n                        // Filter out this candidate and re-evaluate the remaining candidates.\n                        let excluded_id = first_candidate.id.clone();\n                        candidates.retain(|b| b.id != excluded_id);\n                        if candidates.is_empty() {\n                            // All remaining candidates were filtered out, return NoWork.\n                            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n                        }\n                        // Continue with remaining candidates - do not trigger split.\n                        // Jump to stats storage and return the next valid candidate.\n                        // (Skip the rest of the split trigger logic for this iteration.)\n                        return self.evaluate(store, exclusions).await;\n                    }\n\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n                        failure_count = failure_count,\n                        threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n                        \"Split threshold reached, returning Split instruction\"\n                    );\n                    return StrandResult::Split(Box::new(first_candidate.clone()), failure_count);\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\"Split trigger disabled (threshold = 0)\");\n        }\n\n        // 6. Store filtering stats for telemetry access and return result.\n        // These fields persist on the strand instance for access by telemetry emission.\n        self.last_open_count\n            .store(stats.open_count, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        self.last_excluded_count\n            .store(stats.excluded_count, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        *self.last_exclusion_reasons.lock().unwrap() = stats.exclusion_reasons.clone();\n\n        if candidates.is_empty() {\n            // Extract workspace path from store for telemetry.\n            // All beads in a single store should have the same workspace.\n            // Follow KnotStrand pattern (src/strand/knot.rs lines 224-233).\n            let workspace_path = if let Ok(beads) = store.list_all().await {\n                beads\n                    .first()\n                    .and_then(|b| b.workspace.to_str().map(|s| s.to_string()))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n            } else {\n                \"unknown\".to_string()\n            };\n\n            // Emit PluckStarvationDetected telemetry event with filtering statistics.\n            let _ = self\n                .telemetry\n                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::PluckStarvationDetected {\n                    workspace: workspace_path.clone(),\n                    open_count: stats.open_count,\n                    excluded_count: stats.excluded_count,\n                    candidate_exclusion_reasons: stats.exclusion_reasons.clone(),\n                });\n\n            // Write persistent starvation record to NEEDLE workspace if enabled.\n            if self.persistent_starvation_records {\n                if let Err(e) = self.write_starvation_record(\n                    &workspace_path,\n                    stats.open_count,\n                    stats.excluded_count,\n                    &stats.exclusion_reasons,\n                ) {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"Failed to write persistent starvation record\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                workspace = %workspace_path,\n                open_count = stats.open_count,\n                excluded_count = stats.excluded_count,\n                \"Emitted PluckStarvationDetected telemetry, returning NoWork\"\n            );\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        } else {\n            let candidate_ids: Vec<&str> = candidates.iter().map(|b| b.id.as_ref()).collect();\n            tracing::info!(\n                count = candidates.len(),\n                candidates = ?candidate_ids,\n                \"Returning {} candidates for processing\",\n                candidates.len()\n            );\n            StrandResult::BeadFound(candidates)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests
